repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true))
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate polls the sensor only at the start of the 1s cycle. F1 shows motion went true at t=100ms; F2 confirms the JoI emitted no action then. The IR requires a rising-edge wait to block until the transition occurs, then execute the body.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced periodic polling with a rising-edge state machine using `wait until` and a `fired` flag. Set `period` to 1000ms to match the IR cycle period. This ensures the action fires exactly when motion becomes true and repeats every second.
